questions.question: Backend intern candidates were shortlisted via CodeChef contests (Starters 152 Div 1, or a 3-hour, 6-problem contest) instead of a standard OA.

questions.title: Real-World Graph and DP Problems
questions.question: Technical interview with two problems framed around CRED-style scenarios: one graph problem and one dynamic programming problem.

questions.title: Flight Booking Backend (Project Round)
questions.question: Implement core flight booking functions with no UI or DB, following SOLID principles; pass the unit tests and write extra tests for edge cases. The next round asked you to extend it with a new feature.

questions.title: Explain the CAP Theorem
questions.question: After the project discussion, interviewers asked DBMS fundamentals and the CAP theorem.

questions.title: LinkedIn-like Connections System
questions.question: Project round (90 min): build a system where users can connect with each other; modelling it as a graph worked well.

questions.question: Find the shortest path between two files/folders in a file-system tree (BFS), then compare BFS and DFS. Two basic probability questions followed.

questions.title: Count 'Pure Number' Sequences
questions.question: Count digit sequences of length d where a digit can be placed only if it is 0 or some divisor of it (other than 1) appeared earlier; answer mod 1e9+7 (d=1 gives 9, d=2 gives 23).

questions.title: Pure Number Sequences (BE Hiring Test)
questions.question: Backend hiring test (3 problems, 90 min): count length-d digit sequences where each digit is 0 or has a divisor (other than 1) placed earlier, mod 1e9+7.

questions.title: Teamwork and Time Management
questions.question: HR asked about team-work situations, how you manage your time and what skills you want to learn next.

questions.title: Import Each Module Only Once
